evidence.quote: Give reef managers direct, repeatable observations of coral colour over the whole Great Barrier Reef, so that bleaching is detected within days
The satellite would be operated by the Australian Institute of Marine Science (AIMS).

criteria.reasoning: Clear mission goal, quantified objectives/requirements, explicit users and needs, and literature grounding. Minor imprecision in '30 percent more acidic' and some source interpretation, but overall complete and well justified.

evidence.quote: The order follows the mission: the imaging requirements (objectives 1 and 2) fix the orbit altitude and local time
Week 10 is float as well as editing time: no new design work is planned in it.

criteria.reasoning: Robust Gantt and task narrative tied to mission logic, with risk triggers, contingency responses, and planned information sources. STK choice and hand-check strategy are stated. Very complete plan.

evidence.quote: I have also made first hand calculations for a candidate orbit, a circular sun-synchronous orbit at 600 km altitude
A first STK scenario with this orbit has been set up, and its period agrees with the hand calculation.

criteria.reasoning: Good preliminary progress: literature/STK tutorials complete, candidate orbit calculated correctly, and first STK check done. Results are interpreted, though the swath calculation rests on an assumed detector width.

evidence.quote: Figure 1: Project Gantt chart, Weeks 2 to 10 (gold = completed, blue = planned, red lines = report deadlines).
Table 3: Preliminary hand calculations for the candidate orbit.

criteria.reasoning: Well structured, readable, consistent headings, labelled figures/tables, and complete citation matching. Gantt deadline lines are slightly ambiguous but do not impede reading.

technical_issues.issue: The 6,000-pixel across-track detector width is not justified or sourced, yet it fixes the 60 km swath and the single-satellite weekly-coverage shortfall.
'Oceans have become 30 percent more acidic' is imprecise; ocean acidification is usually described by pH decrease or hydrogen-ion increase, not a 30% acidity rise.
Only one red deadline line is visible and the final 20/11 deadline is not clearly marked on the Gantt chart.

overall: Strong preliminary report: clear GBR bleaching mission, users, requirements, robust Gantt/risk plan, STK selection, and correct hand calculations. Minor caveats are the unjustified detector-width assumption and optimistic single-satellite weekly coverage. Presentation and referencing are excellent; well on track.
